entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The adult man in the image-left foreground, with short brown hair parted to the side and a mustache, wearing a dark purple jacket with red piping, a white shirt, and a black bow tie, and holding a note and pen.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The young man behind and to the image-right of Person A, wearing a dark purple stand-collar uniform and a matching cylindrical hat with two lines of gold text reading “LOBBY BOY” on the front.

entities.name: red patterned carpet
entities.identification: The red carpet in the lower part of the image and in the passage on the right, with a light-colored pattern partially visible on the right in the final frame.

entities.name: ivory-white double doors
entities.identification: The light-colored double doors in the image-left background, with an arched door surround and large light-colored panels.

entities.name: cream-pink wall
entities.identification: The light warm-pink wall behind the people, with light-colored trim lines and vertical rectangular sections.

entities.name: group of wall-mounted light fixtures
entities.identification: The warm-white illuminated fixtures on the wall, including light-colored vertical shades and small lights high on the wall.

entities.name: small round table in the lobby
entities.identification: The brown round table in front of the sofa, with a circular tabletop, table rim, and part of a dark support visible.

entities.name: guests and staff in the background
entities.identification: The group of background people other than the main characters, including the person whose brown hat is visible at the beginning of the clip and the balding person visible later.

entities.name: light blue-gray striped sofa
entities.identification: The light-colored striped upholstered sofa against the wall, with a curved backrest framed by a dark border, appearing grayish beige overall under the warm light.

entities.name: geometric-patterned floor
entities.identification: The light-based, dark-patterned floor visible outside the red-carpeted area.

entities.name: cups and saucers on the tabletop
entities.identification: The small vessel on the round table with a light-colored circular rim.

entities.name: forked floor stand
entities.identification: The dark slender-rod stand in the rectangular background area on the right in the final segment, with a top that forks outward and a lower end connected to a wider base.
